title: Kinetic modulation enabling densely oriented electrodeposition of Zn anodes in aqueous batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04200C, Paper
Kuo Wang, Hongtu Zhan, Xiao-Xia Liu, Xiaoqi Sun
The unique charge distribution on the 2-methoxyethyl acetate additive enables the thermodynamic governed Zn deposition behavior in aqueous electrolytes, thereby extending the lifespan of Zn electrodes from 79 hours to around 8 months.
